name: Fresh Ripe Hass Avocado (Mashed or Sliced)
whyItWorks: Rich in calorie-dense monounsaturated oleic fatty acids and potassium, ripe avocado provides crucial calories and micronutrients when weight loss has occurred. Its fiber is mostly soluble, yielding a silky, non-abrasive puree.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat 1/4 to 1/2 ripe avocado mashed onto white sourdough toast, white rice, or sliced alongside eggs. Mash with a fork to ensure smooth breakdown.
watchOuts: Contains sorbitol and high healthy fat; limit portion to 1/4 or 1/2 avocado at a time to prevent rapid bile dumping.
